problem: Determine whether a demonstrated bottleneck warrants changing the frozen Pipeline 3 baseline before final evaluation.
hypothesis: The selected hybrid is converged under the established schedule; extending or changing the model would be an unproven optimization rather than a correction.
risk: Changing loss, capacity, schedule, weighting, or fusion after a single validation split could overfit validation and break comparability with the established Pipeline 3 design.
validation_plan: Retain the baseline scientific configuration and use the predetermined seed-29 repeat only to assess stability.
result: No repair was justified. Seed-29 differed by -0.0253 pp validation MAE and +0.00176 validation cross-entropy; the baseline seed-17 hybrid remains selected by the predeclared validation-loss criterion.

P2: Physical-only training remains validation-improving at epoch 60, but it is not competitive with the selected hybrid and does not justify altering the final configuration.
P3: One-time CROMA feature extraction is I/O/compute intensive but cacheable.
P4: The live 192-dimensional seeded HybridFusion must remain explicitly labeled representation-only and must not be conflated with the evaluated 830-dimensional scientific hybrid.
